head: Pinvoy opens shared map links in the navigation app you use
dek: When someone sends you a location, Pinvoy opens the exact place in your own navigation app, like Google Maps, Waze, Apple Maps or Sygic, or a ride app like Uber. It was #97 among paid Navigation apps on the US App Store on 3 November.
details: It reads links from many map apps, short links, plain coordinates and Plus Codes. It costs $2.99 with in-app purchases, by developer Abdulmohsen Al Tulaihi.
means: If shared locations keep opening in the wrong map app, this sends them to the one you drive with.
todo: Share a map link to Pinvoy from WhatsApp or Messages, then pick your navigation app.
thumb_words: OPEN MAP LINKS IN YOUR APP
